request.query: Length of divided derivatives of a polynomial bounded by two to degree times length

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_hasseDeriv_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) p).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - n

items.name: Polynomial.degree_derivative_le
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R}, (Polynomial.derivative p).degree ≤ p.degree

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_iterate_derivative
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (k : ℕ),
  ((⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[k] p).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - k

items.name: Polynomial.derivative'
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → Derivation R (Polynomial R) (Polynomial R)

items.name: Polynomial.derivative
items.type: {R : Type u} → [inst : Semiring R] → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: Polynomial.iterate_derivative_eq_zero
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R} {x : ℕ}, p.natDegree < x → (⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[x] p = 0

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_derivative_le
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R), (Polynomial.derivative p).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - 1

items.name: Polynomial.degree_derivative_eq
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] [IsAddTorsionFree R] (p : Polynomial R),
  0 < p.natDegree → (Polynomial.derivative p).degree = ↑(p.natDegree - 1)
